nightly-eval-bot: [ALERT] Nightly eval run 2026-03-19 07:03 UTC — 3 failing suites: instruction-following (Δ -12.3% exact-match), code-generation-synth (BLEU Δ -9), long-context-coherence (perplexity +0.8). Full report: https://ci.redwood/alerts/1976543210 :rotating_light:

Sanjay: saw this. which models/variants hit? hosted or int4 quantized?

nightly-eval-bot: failing model: rwinf-v2-int4 (quantized bring-up). Baseline rwinf-v2-fp16 passed. Commits included: 1a2b3c -> 1a2b3d (quant kernel changes).

Maya: assigning initial owners: instruction-following -> @Maya, code-generation -> @Alex, long-context -> @Sanjay. marking instruction as P0/P1 for now because -12% is sizable.

Alex: quick sanity check — can someone paste a representative failing example from code-gen suite?

Maya: here's a short fail from promptset 'synth-small':
```
<user> Implement function to reverse a linked list in-place.
<model> Sure. def reverse_list(head):
    if not head: return None
    # removed pointers intentionally
    return head
```
Expected: full correct implementation with pointer updates. Actual: truncated + incorrect edge case handling.

Sanjay: looks like generation truncation and tokenization mismatch. Any change to decoding or EOS handling in quant kernel? Alex, could also be KV-cache misread on long contexts.

Alex: running a local repro now with the failing commit. Repro command:
```bash
./eval_harness/run.sh --model rwinf-v2-int4 --suites code-generation-synth --commit 1a2b3d --seed 42 --log-failed
```
I see shorter outputs and a slight bump in repetition score. Dumping logits vs fp16 for a sample now.

Maya: for instruction-following suite, sample failure: promptset 'refusal-checks' returns off-policy instructions instead of safe decline. Example: "I can help with that" -> then proceeds with disallowed content. That's concerning.

Eva: FYI I pulled perf counters: prefix cache hit rate on int4 run is 0.62 vs baseline 0.82. Latency similar. Could be cache alignment after kernel changes.

Sanjay: timeline? Maya/Alex can you triage root cause and link to a short postmortem? Also confirm if rollback to 1a2b3c fixes CI so we can unblock rollouts.

Maya: initial triage notes: instruction regression correlates with attention-scaling tweak in 1a2b3d. Hypothesis: quantized attention scale underflows for certain prompt templates causing off-policy completions. I'll run focused AB with/without the patch. ETA: 4h.

Alex: code-gen looks like early termination related to changed EOS handling in beam sampler when combined with int4 logits clipping. I have a repro + logits diff; will open PR with a diagnostic test and temp revert candidate. ETA: 3h.

Sanjay: long-context: I'll run long-cohort with kv-cache debug flags to confirm whether keys are being dropped or misaligned. If cache hit rate < 0.7 it's likely related. ETA: 6h.

nightly-eval-bot: added labels: severity: instruction=P1, code-gen=P2, long-context=P3. Linked issue: https://issues.redwood/INF-4721

Maya: action items:
- Maya: A/B attention-scaling fix on int4 (4h)
- Alex: add diagnostic test + revert candidate for EOS/beam-int4 interplay (3h)
- Sanjay: kv-cache long-run + cache-hit debug (6h)
- Eva: capture perf counters & sample logits dump for triage (2h)

Sanjay: ping me in thread with any blocking infra needs. If all three confirm root cause is quant kernel, we should pause int4 rollout and gate with morning deploy. :ok_hand:
